environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on EC2 behind ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL is attached to the ALB with two rule groups: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with default action BLOCK and SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule overridden to COUNT, and (2) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action and sensitivity level set to HIGH. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB access logs are enabled to S3 with real-time CloudWatch metric filters, though these are observability-only. The EC2 instance runs with an IAM instance profile that has no S3 or SSM permissions (only CloudWatch logs:PutLogEvents). SQLite database file is on an encrypted EBS volume with dm-crypt.

config.network: Public subnet, SG allows 80/443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
